name: registercheck
description: Look up German companies in the commercial register (Handelsregister): profiles, officers, shareholders, register events, the text of register documents, people by name, and monitoring for register changes.

interface.longDescription:
Registercheck brings the German commercial register (Handelsregister) into ChatGPT. Find a German company by its name or by its register court and number, and read what the register says about it: legal form, registered address, share capital, business purpose, managing directors and other officers, the shareholders on the latest shareholder list, the history of register entries, and which register documents are on file. Read a document itself in the chat, such as the current register extract or the shareholder list.

With your Registercheck account you can also monitor companies for register changes and read the alerts your monitors raised.

Who it is for: compliance and KYC teams, lawyers, sales and procurement teams, investors and journalists who need facts about German companies from the register.

How it works: sign in with your Registercheck account, or connect with an API key of your Registercheck workspace on the sign-in page if the workspace allows it. Answers come from Registercheck's copy of the register and carry the date of the last register entry they are based on. People in the register can be found by name, with their date of birth and city as registered.

Limitations: covers companies registered in Germany only. It does not file or change register entries. A scanned document without a text layer comes as a short-lived download link instead of text.
capabilities: Search German companies by name or register number
Find people in the register with their date of birth
Read the text of register documents
defaultPrompt: Who are the managing directors of tado GmbH?
Show the register profile of HelloFresh SE.

positive.description: Read a register document's text in the chat: the current register extract on file.
positive.prompt: Read me the current register extract of tado GmbH.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds tado GmbH (Amtsgericht München, HRB 194769), takes its current register extract from the documents on file and reads it out from the extract's text: register court and number, the registered address in München and the managing directors Christian Deilmann and Johannes Schwarz.

positive.prompt: Show me the register profile of HelloFresh SE: legal form, address, share capital and business purpose.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows HelloFresh SE (Amtsgericht Charlottenburg, HRB 182382), Prinzenstraße 89, 10969 Berlin, share capital EUR 159,000,000, its registered business purpose (recipes and food products), and the date of the last register entry the data is based on.

positive.description: List the people who represent a company.
positive.prompt: Who are the current managing directors of tado GmbH?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the current managing directors (Geschäftsführer) Christian Deilmann and Johannes Schwarz, by name only: a role names its holder and nothing else about them. Former directors are listed only when the user asks for them.

positive.description: Find who owns a company, from the latest shareholder list on file.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports GetYourGuide AG, Zürich, Switzerland, as the sole shareholder with 100% (EUR 25,000 nominal), according to the latest shareholder list on file.

positive.description: Monitor a company for register changes in the connected workspace (a write; ChatGPT asks for confirmation).
positive.prompt: Notify me about register changes at HelloFresh SE, then show me which companies I monitor.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts monitoring HelloFresh SE in the reviewer workspace, or says it is already monitored, and then lists the workspace's monitored companies including HelloFresh SE.

negative.description: A company outside Germany. Registercheck covers the German registers only.
negative.prompt: Show me the Companies House filing history of Tesco PLC in the United Kingdom.
negative.expected_behavior: No Registercheck tool is called. The assistant explains that Registercheck covers companies registered in Germany only.

negative.description: Buying credits or a plan. The plugin sells nothing in ChatGPT; plans are only managed on registercheck.de.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 more Registercheck credits for my account.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called and no purchase or checkout starts. The assistant explains that credits and plans cannot be bought through ChatGPT.

negative.description: Changing the commercial register. Registercheck reads register data; filings go through a notary to the register court.
negative.prompt: Register a new managing director for tado GmbH in the Handelsregister.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. The assistant explains that Registercheck cannot file or change register entries.

review.commerce_description: Registercheck sells nothing in ChatGPT. Signed-in users use the features their existing Registercheck account includes.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: read a register document's text in the chat, such as the current register extract or the shareholder list (scans without a text layer come as a download link); find people in the register by name with their date of birth and city as registered; connect with a workspace API key on the sign-in page as an alternative to signing in with an account.

de-DE.subtitle: Daten aus dem Handelsregister
de-DE.description:
Registercheck bringt das deutsche Handelsregister in ChatGPT. Finde eine deutsche Firma über ihren Namen oder über Registergericht und Registernummer, und lies, was das Register über sie sagt: Rechtsform, Anschrift, Stammkapital, Unternehmensgegenstand, Geschäftsführer und andere Vertretungsberechtigte, die Gesellschafter laut der letzten Gesellschafterliste, die Historie der Registereinträge und welche Registerdokumente vorliegen. Lies ein Dokument selbst im Chat, etwa den aktuellen Registerauszug oder die Gesellschafterliste.

Mit deinem Registercheck-Konto überwachst du Firmen auf Registeränderungen und liest die Meldungen deiner Überwachungen.

So funktioniert es: Melde dich mit deinem Registercheck-Konto an, oder verbinde dich auf der Anmeldeseite mit einem API-Schlüssel deines Registercheck-Arbeitsbereichs, wenn der Arbeitsbereich das erlaubt. Die Antworten stammen aus Registerchecks Abbild des Registers und nennen das Datum der letzten Registereintragung, auf der sie beruhen. Personen im Register findest du über ihren Namen, mit Geburtsdatum und Wohnort, wie sie eingetragen sind.

Grenzen: nur in Deutschland eingetragene Firmen. Keine Anmeldungen zum Register. Ein gescanntes Dokument ohne Textebene kommt als kurz gültiger Download-Link statt als Text.
